subject.title: Allow `stt-tts` mode in browser Talk (`talk.client.create`) so configured speech/TTS providers and local models can be used

question: Should OpenClaw add a browser-managed-room STT/TTS flow for configured speech providers and agent models, or retain Browser Talk as a realtime-provider surface and clarify that boundary in the UI and docs?
rationale: Current main documents this separation as an intentional ownership and transport contract, so accepting the feature requires choosing a new browser product path rather than correcting a broken configuration lookup.

options.title: Sponsor browser managed-room Talk
options.body: Add a browser capture/playback implementation over the existing managed-room STT/TTS contract, with focused protocol, UI, privacy, and lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep browser realtime-only
options.body: Retain the current client-owned provider design and update the Control UI and Talk docs so TTS settings are not presented as applicable to Browser Talk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor browser managed-room Talk
recommendation.body: Add a browser capture/playback implementation over the existing managed-room STT/TTS contract, with focused protocol, UI, privacy, and lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-boundary product and architecture decision affecting core Talk ownership rather than a narrow provider implementation detail.
